title: Canonical localized derived pullback with independent universes
statement: For g:V.toScheme -> W.toScheme, with V an open of U.toScheme and U an open of S and W an open of T, supply independent derived localizations on W and on the localized module site over V. Define a functor from the supplied derived category on W to the supplied derived category of localized modules over V: use the canonical localization equivalence from W to its standard localization, the existing derived tensor pullback along g in standard localizations, and the exact inverse open-site equivalence derived with the supplied target localization. This is an actual composite of already constructed functors, with its objects and maps specified by these constructions.

proof.text: Compose the canonical localization equivalence from the supplied W model to its standard model, standard derived pullback along g, and the exact derived inverse localized-site equivalence. The existing localization uniqueness construction specifies its objects and maps. No mere-existence witness or unresolved data is used.
